releases.displayName: We’re Back to Take Out Bugs. Our Latest Patch is Landing NOW!

items.text: It’s time for an upgrade! If you drop into the fight in MARVEL Cosmic Invasion you’ll find a new update, packed with fixes and quality-of-life tweaks. This bug-blasting patch is live now on all platforms, so suit up, jump in and get back into the fight, Super Heroes!
We’ve fixed an issue which would prevent the “Special Attack Assemble” achievement from triggering in online modes
We’ve given Wolverine and She-Hulk a pep talk - fixing their grab attack and stopping them from freezing mid action.
We’ve fixed Annihilus moving out of view if his armor is broken by She-Hulk’s Spinning throw
We’ve also stopped Annihilus from become intangible if his armor is broken by Wolverine’s grab and slash attack
We’ve fixed missing subtitles for Spider-Man’s first post-Annihilus battle dialogue
We’ve fixed a blocker that meant the last player couldn’t pick an already-selected Super Hero in Arcade Mode (even if the Doppleganger modifier was turned on)
We’ve fixed an issue where move lists were displaying incorrectly in multiplayer, if Player One was using a keyboard
We’ve also had a chat with Hela to ensure she doesn’t get bored and go idle if host players leave a multiplayer game during the fight
We’ve also fixed achievement-related freezes on Windows and Xbox, as well as various crash issues on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2
We’ve fixed an issue that was making it impossible to change Super Hero’s colour profile after hitting Continue for Arcade mode
We’ve fixed the life bar showing incorrect costumes when changing characters
We’ve made sure that feedback is shown correctly when Super Heroes run out of ammo
We’ve also fixed an issue where over-time damage numbers from Phyla-Vell’s cosmic damage was not displaying correctly in multiplayer
We’ve fixed character select inconsistencies which could cause Super Hero icons to be incorrectly greyed out

Whatever platform it has come from, we wanted to say thank you to all the Super Heroes out there who are joining the fight in MARVEL Cosmic Invasion and have come to give us feedback. The detail you’ve provided has been instrumental in helping us to squash these bugs.
The MARVEL Cosmic Invasion team at Tribute Games and Dotemu

releases.displayName: Our Bug Blasting First Patch is Live NOW

items.text: Super Heroes! What an incredible launch day we had, and we wanted to get a big thank you out to you for your out-of-this-world support. The team at Tribute Games have been fighting their own battle against the bugs, and we've got some fixes on their way to you right now!
Fixes!
Heteropteron Blocker - We’ve fixed an issue where having camera shake effects OFF would stop the cinematic from triggering, keeping Super Heroes trapped in Stage 13
Multiplayer Crashing - We’ve fixed an issue where joining a multi-player game session and resetting story progress would trigger a crash
Enemy Cheating! - We’ve fixed an issue where Master Mold would become invulnerable and non-targetable, which if anything was just rude
Venom Issues - We’ve fixed issues where Venom could become frozen after being parried during Symbiote Pounce or immediately lose armor during Venom Bite
Upgrade Blocking - We’ve fixed an issue that would mean Super Heroes’ stats did not upgrade after levelling up unless players returned to the main menu.
Enemy Superpowers - We’ve fixed an issue where enemies would deal abnormally high damage on their first hit during a grab
Annihilus Invulnerability - We’ve fixed an issue (and related issues) where Annihilus wouldn’t re-enter the staggered/vulnerable state and players couldn’t deal damage
Where’s Hela?! - Fixed an issue where Hela could de-synchronise while teleporting
Annihilus Forever! - We fixed an issue where Annihilus wouldn’t stop attacking after his shield breaks
Multiplayer Connections - Fixed an issue which could cause problems when the host disconnects while Super Heroes are joining a lobby (this should now simply return you to the multiplayer menu)
Reigning in She-Hulk - Option now added to have controller shake only for players controlling the character (meaning that She-Hulk’s controller vibration only happens for the player controlling her)
Cosmic Hold On What?! - We’ve fixed an issue where Super Heroes would sometimes be swapped when respawning
At Least Credit Me - The character who threw the enemy will now be considered the instigator when determining who gets credit for knocking down an assembly line bomb
Cosmic Stability - We’ve deployed some additional protection for lobby stability when players reach Game Over in Arcade Mode
Interrogating the Vampire - We’ve fixed an issue which prevented Super Heroes from using the Vampire modifier in Arcade Mode
Choose your character! - We've fixed the issue with the characters' order in character select for Steam Deck and Linux. That should fix the online desync/crashs between Steam Deck and other versions
Smaller Fixes
Fixed an issue where intro music was used instead of main stage music where players joined later in Stage 2 (Genosha)
Fixed MODOK’s movement and behaviours (quite a lot of fixes here, actually)
Tweaked Beta Ray Bill’s no-hammer attack to ensure it doesn’t register as a multi attack
Fixed an issue where some enemies would do multiple hits instead of the expected one hit attack
Fixed an issue where enemies would walk without actually moving
Tweaked visuals to stop the OK / Back popup appearing while fading out.
Negative Blast now automatically faces the center of the screen
Worm enemies will now animate properly when turning to face their enemies
The Mission Select timer should now count down correctly in Arcade Mode
We’ve fixed an issue where players could immediately spawn in a pit when joining a mid-session lobby
Cancelling character selection will not reset the selected skin
Fixed visual glitching during tally and post-boss cutscenes
Fixed Super Heroes appearing multiple times when confronting Annihilus
Fixed an issue where Annihilus would play an incorrect animation following the Negative Wave attack
Fixed an issue where egg spawners would not always appear in the correct state
Fixed an issue where Bug Barricade dealt multiple attacks and a huge amount of damage
Fixed online synchronisation issues related to Sentry Laser and Statue
Fixed small graphical shadow errors
Fixed a challenge completion issue related to multi-hit tasks

Another huge thank you to all of the Super Heroes who have jumped into MARVEL Cosmic Invasion. Whatever platform you are on, your support means everything, and your feedback is critical to making the cosmos the best it can be, and pushing Annihilus back into the Negative Zone!
We’ll squash those bugs, together! Please keep getting your feedback and bug reports in to the team. A cosmic battle awaits!
The MARVEL Cosmic Invasion team at Tribute Games and Dotemu
